subtitles.zh: 这更像是一个窗口，让我们了解这家公司的预期。是的，它的收入大幅增长，但亏损也同样大幅增加。
subtitles.en: More of a window into what this company is expecting. Yes, its revenue has taken a big step up, but so too have its losses.

subtitles.zh: 对于这份S1文件中我们了解到的一些数据，你的初步反应是什么？
subtitles.en: What is your initial reaction to some of the figures we're learning about in this S1?

subtitles.zh: 我们的初步反应是，这家公司未来有着非凡的增长轨迹。
subtitles.en: Our initial reaction is that this company has an extraordinary growth trajectory ahead of itself.

subtitles.zh: 这得益于创新和对模型的执行，然后将其转化为Claude Codd或co-work等领域的收入。
subtitles.en: It's driven by the innovation and the execution on the models and then transforming that into revenue in areas like Claude Codd or co-work.

subtitles.zh: 就配置而言，关键点是，是的，数字非常惊人。
subtitles.en: The key in terms of the investments is, yes, the numbers are extraordinary.

subtitles.zh: 它们将继续增长，但他们正在将这些配置变现。
subtitles.en: They'll continue to grow, but they're monetizing these investments.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这种在增长之前进行配置的推拉效应，我认为将在未来几个月内持续存在。
subtitles.en: And so this push and pull in terms of investing ahead of some of the growth, I think, will be with us for the next several months.

subtitles.zh: 但如果公司能够继续创新，执行其技术路线图，那么我认为未来一年我们将看到Anthropic的增长是持久的。
subtitles.en: But if the company can continue to innovate, execute on its technology roadmap, then I think what we'll see in the year ahead is that growth for anthropic is durable

subtitles.zh: 并且他们将继续扩展到新的领域。
subtitles.en: and they're going to continue to expand into newer areas.

subtitles.zh: 持久的增长和向新领域的扩展。Danny和我还讨论了一些市场参与者可能有的担忧，即他们的收入集中。
subtitles.en: Durable growth and expanding in newer areas. Danny and I have also been talking about some of the concerns that some investors may have that they have their revenue concentrated

subtitles.zh: 仅集中在少数几家公司，但公司表示，今年第三季度近80%的收入来自前五大客户以外的客户。
subtitles.en: in just a few companies, but actually the company said that nearly 80% of the revenue came from customers outside of the top five customers for their third quarter of the year.

subtitles.zh: 这在一定程度上缓解了那些担忧，丹，你怎么看？
subtitles.en: So that kind of alleviates any of those concerns, any thoughts on that, Dan?

subtitles.zh: 是的，很多收入将通过谷歌云、亚马逊云服务等云提供商及其合作伙伴实现，
subtitles.en: Yes, and so a lot of the revenue is going to go through cloud providers such as Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services, their partners, of course,

subtitles.zh: 当然还有微软Azure。
subtitles.en: Microsoft Azure as well.

subtitles.zh: 这更像是一个窗口，让我们了解这家公司的预期。是的，它的收入大幅增长，但亏损也同样大幅增加。
subtitles.en: More of a window into what this company is expecting. Yes, its revenue has taken a big step up, but so too have its losses.

subtitles.zh: 对于这份S1文件中我们了解到的一些数据，你的初步反应是什么？
subtitles.en: What is your initial reaction to some of the figures we're learning about in this S1?

subtitles.zh: 我们的初步反应是，这家公司未来有着非凡的增长轨迹。
subtitles.en: Our initial reaction is that this company has an extraordinary growth trajectory ahead of itself.

subtitles.zh: 这得益于创新和对模型的执行，然后将其转化为Claude Codd或co-work等领域的收入。
subtitles.en: It's driven by the innovation and the execution on the models and then transforming that into revenue in areas like Claude Codd or co-work.

subtitles.zh: 就配置而言，关键点是，是的，数字非常惊人。
subtitles.en: The key in terms of the investments is, yes, the numbers are extraordinary.

subtitles.zh: 它们将继续增长，但他们正在将这些配置变现。
subtitles.en: They'll continue to grow, but they're monetizing these investments.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这种在增长之前进行配置的推拉效应，我认为将在未来几个月内持续存在。
subtitles.en: And so this push and pull in terms of investing ahead of some of the growth, I think, will be with us for the next several months.

subtitles.zh: 但如果公司能够继续创新，执行其技术路线图，那么我认为未来一年我们将看到Anthropic的增长是持久的。
subtitles.en: But if the company can continue to innovate, execute on its technology roadmap, then I think what we'll see in the year ahead is that growth for anthropic is durable

subtitles.zh: 并且他们将继续扩展到新的领域。
subtitles.en: and they're going to continue to expand into newer areas.

subtitles.zh: 持久的增长和向新领域的扩展。Danny和我还讨论了一些市场参与者可能有的担忧，即他们的收入集中。
subtitles.en: Durable growth and expanding in newer areas. Danny and I have also been talking about some of the concerns that some investors may have that they have their revenue concentrated

subtitles.zh: 仅集中在少数几家公司，但公司表示，今年第三季度近80%的收入来自前五大客户以外的客户。
subtitles.en: in just a few companies, but actually the company said that nearly 80% of the revenue came from customers outside of the top five customers for their third quarter of the year.

subtitles.zh: 这在一定程度上缓解了那些担忧，丹，你怎么看？
subtitles.en: So that kind of alleviates any of those concerns, any thoughts on that, Dan?

subtitles.zh: 是的，很多收入将通过谷歌云、亚马逊云服务等云提供商及其合作伙伴实现，
subtitles.en: Yes, and so a lot of the revenue is going to go through cloud providers such as Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services, their partners, of course,

subtitles.zh: 当然还有微软Azure。
subtitles.en: Microsoft Azure as well.
